theorem ramIdx_of_residue_eq {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    {φ : M.K} {P : Place M.K} (h : φ ∈ P.1) {c : ℚ}
    (hc : P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩ = algebraMap ℚ P.ResidueField c) :
    ramIdx M hDVR φ P = ord M hDVR P (φ - algebraMap ℚ M.K c)

definitions.Model: For N : ℕ, K : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)); u,v : K; Transcendental ℚ u; u^N + v^N = 1; ℚ⟮u,v⟯ = ⊤; finite_u : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮u⟯ K; Module.finrank ℚ⟮u⟯ K = N.
definitions.Place: All valuation subrings O of K with O ≠ ⊤ and ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O. No affine chart restriction.
definitions.ResiduesFinite: ∀ P : Place M.K, FiniteDimensional ℚ P.ResidueField.
definitions.residue: IsLocalRing.residue P.1 : P.1 →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1; the residue field has its induced characteristic-zero and rational algebra structures.
definitions.ord: -WithZero.log (((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation M.K) f), with the IsDiscreteValuationRing instance supplied by hDVR P. This integer order is totalized by ord P 0 = 0.
definitions.ramIdx: if h : φ ∈ P.1 then ord M hDVR P (Polynomial.aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ,h⟩))) else -ord M hDVR P φ; its codomain is ℤ.
definitions.cusps: {P | ord M hDVR P φ ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < ord M hDVR P (φ - 1)}.
definitions.IsBelyi: Transcendental ℚ φ ∧ ∀ P : Place M.K, 1 < ramIdx M hDVR φ P → P ∈ cusps M hDVR φ.
definitions.cuspDivisor: ∑ P ∈ hfin.toFinset, Finsupp.single P 1, as a finitely supported integer function on all places; its coefficient is 1 at a cusp and 0 otherwise.

statements.en: For every natural number $N$ and every model $M$, let $K=M.K$ be an intermediate field over $\mathbb{Q}$ in the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb{Q}(T)$, with specified $u,v\in K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb{Q}$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $K=\mathbb{Q}(u,v)$, and $K/\mathbb{Q}(u)$ is finite dimensional of degree $N$. Assume $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$: every proper valuation subring of $K$ containing every rational constant is a discrete valuation ring. A place $P$ means any such proper valuation subring $\mathcal{O}_P$, with residue field $\kappa(P)$ and quotient homomorphism $\operatorname{res}_P:\mathcal{O}_P\to\kappa(P)$; this carrier includes places at infinity. Write $i_K$ and $i_P$ for the rational algebra maps into $K$ and $\kappa(P)$. Write $\operatorname{ord}_P(f)\in\mathbb{Z}$ for the negative exponent of the normalized multiplicative valuation associated with the maximal ideal of $\mathcal{O}_P$, using the discrete valuation ring structure supplied by $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ and the totalization $\operatorname{ord}_P(0)=0$. For every $\varphi\in K$, every such $P$, every proof $h$ that $\varphi\in\mathcal{O}_P$, and every $c\in\mathbb{Q}$, if $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)=i_P(c)$, then $e_\varphi(P)=\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi-i_K(c))$, where at this regular place the integer $e_\varphi(P)$ is defined to be $\operatorname{ord}_P(m_P(\varphi))$ and $m_P(X)$ is the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb{Q}$ of the actual residue $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)$. No transcendence or nonzero assumption is imposed on $\varphi$ or $\varphi-i_K(c)$, and no finite-dimensionality assumption is imposed on $\kappa(P)/\mathbb{Q}$; in particular, when $\varphi=i_K(c)$ the orders of zero use the stated totalization.
statements.zh_Hans: 对任意自然数 $N$ 及任意模型 $M$，令 $K=M.K$ 为固定的 $\mathbb{Q}(T)$ 的代数闭包中的一个含 $\mathbb{Q}$ 的中间域，并给定 $u,v\in K$，满足 $u$ 在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=\mathbb{Q}(u,v)$，且 $K/\mathbb{Q}(u)$ 是次数为 $N$ 的有限维扩张。假设 $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$：$K$ 中每个包含全部有理常数且不等于 $K$ 的赋值子环都是离散赋值环。这里的一个处 $P$ 就是任意这样的赋值子环 $\mathcal{O}_P$，其剩余域为 $\kappa(P)$，商同态为 $\operatorname{res}_P:\mathcal{O}_P\to\kappa(P)$；这个处的集合包括无穷远处。用 $i_K$ 和 $i_P$ 分别表示到 $K$ 和 $\kappa(P)$ 的有理数代数映射。令 $\operatorname{ord}_P(f)\in\mathbb{Z}$ 为由 $\mathcal{O}_P$ 的极大理想给出的规范化乘法赋值的指数的相反数，其中离散赋值环结构由 $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ 提供，并约定 $\operatorname{ord}_P(0)=0$。对每个 $\varphi\in K$、每个这样的处 $P$、每个证明 $\varphi\in\mathcal{O}_P$ 的 $h$ 及每个 $c\in\mathbb{Q}$，若 $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)=i_P(c)$，则 $e_\varphi(P)=\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi-i_K(c))$；在此正则处，整数 $e_\varphi(P)$ 定义为 $\operatorname{ord}_P(m_P(\varphi))$，其中 $m_P(X)$ 是实际剩余类 $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)$ 在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上的极小多项式。此声明不假设 $\varphi$ 或 $\varphi-i_K(c)$ 超越或非零，也不假设 $\kappa(P)/\mathbb{Q}$ 有限维；特别地，当 $\varphi=i_K(c)$ 时，零的阶数按上述约定取值。
statements.ja: 任意の自然数 $N$ と任意のモデル $M$ に対し、$K=M.K$ は固定された $\mathbb{Q}(T)$ の代数閉包内の $\mathbb{Q}$ 上の中間体であり、指定された $u,v\in K$ は、$u$ が $\mathbb{Q}$ 上超越的であること、$u^N+v^N=1$、$K=\mathbb{Q}(u,v)$、および $K/\mathbb{Q}(u)$ が次数 $N$ の有限次拡大であることを満たすものとする。仮定 $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ は、有理定数をすべて含み $K$ 全体とは異なる任意の付値部分環が離散付値環であるという条件である。素点 $P$ はこのような任意の付値部分環 $\mathcal{O}_P$ を意味し、その剰余体を $\kappa(P)$、商準同型を $\operatorname{res}_P:\mathcal{O}_P\to\kappa(P)$ とする。この素点の全体には無限遠の素点も含まれる。$i_K$ と $i_P$ をそれぞれ $K$ と $\kappa(P)$ への有理数の代数写像とする。$\operatorname{ord}_P(f)\in\mathbb{Z}$ は、$h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ が与える離散付値環構造を用い、$\mathcal{O}_P$ の極大イデアルに付随する正規化された乗法的付値の指数の符号を反転したものであり、$\operatorname{ord}_P(0)=0$ と全域化する。任意の $\varphi\in K$、任意のそのような $P$、$\varphi\in\mathcal{O}_P$ の任意の証明 $h$、および任意の $c\in\mathbb{Q}$ に対し、$\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)=i_P(c)$ ならば、$e_\varphi(P)=\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi-i_K(c))$ である。ここで、この正則な素点における整数 $e_\varphi(P)$ は $\operatorname{ord}_P(m_P(\varphi))$ と定義され、$m_P(X)$ は実際の剰余類 $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)$ の $\mathbb{Q}$ 上の最小多項式である。$\varphi$ や $\varphi-i_K(c)$ に超越性または非零性を仮定せず、$\kappa(P)/\mathbb{Q}$ の有限次元性も仮定しない。特に $\varphi=i_K(c)$ の場合には、零の位数に上記の全域化を用いる。

theorem belyiCanonicalCuspCoefficientIdentity_source {N : ℕ}
    (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M)
    (φ : M.K) (hφ : IsBelyi M hDVR φ)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) :
    ∀ P : Place M.K,
      (if φ ∈ P.1 then ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1
        else -ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) + cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin P =
        poleMultiplicity M hDVR φ P + ord M hDVR P (φ * (φ - 1))

statements.en: For every natural number $N$ and every model $M$, let $K=M.K$ be an intermediate field over $\mathbb{Q}$ in the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb{Q}(T)$, with specified $u,v\in K$ satisfying: $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb{Q}$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $K=\mathbb{Q}(u,v)$, and $K/\mathbb{Q}(u)$ is finite dimensional of degree $N$. A place $P$ is any valuation subring $\mathcal{O}_P$ of $K$ that is not $K$ and contains every rational constant; all these places are used, including places at infinity. Assume $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$: every $\mathcal{O}_P$ is a discrete valuation ring, and $h_{\mathrm{RF}}$: every residue field $\kappa(P)$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb{Q}$. Let $\operatorname{res}_P:\mathcal{O}_P\to\kappa(P)$ be the residue quotient map and let $\operatorname{ord}_P(f)\in\mathbb{Z}$ be the negative exponent of the normalized multiplicative valuation associated with the maximal ideal of $\mathcal{O}_P$, using $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ and totalized by $\operatorname{ord}_P(0)=0$. For $\varphi\in K$, define the integer $e_\varphi(P)$ to be $\operatorname{ord}_P(m_P(\varphi))$ if $\varphi\in\mathcal{O}_P$, where $m_P(X)$ is the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb{Q}$ of its actual residue $\operatorname{res}_P(\varphi)$, and to be $-\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi)$ otherwise. Define $C_\varphi=\{P:\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi)\ne0\ \text{or}\ 0<\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi-1)\}$. Assume $h_\varphi$: $\varphi$ is transcendental over $\mathbb{Q}$ and, for every place $P$, $1<e_\varphi(P)$ implies $P\in C_\varphi$. For every supplied proof $h_{\mathrm{fin}}$ that this particular set $C_\varphi$ is finite, let $D_{\varphi,h_{\mathrm{fin}}}=\sum_{Q\in C_\varphi}[Q]$, the finitely supported integer divisor with coefficient $1$ on $C_\varphi$ and $0$ elsewhere, formed using that same finiteness proof. Then for every place $P$ the following equality of integers holds: $\bigl(\begin{cases}e_\varphi(P)-1,&\varphi\in\mathcal{O}_P,\\-e_\varphi(P)-1,&\varphi\notin\mathcal{O}_P\end{cases}\bigr)+D_{\varphi,h_{\mathrm{fin}}}(P)=\max\{0,-\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi)\}+\operatorname{ord}_P(\varphi(\varphi-1))$. The maximum is the defined pole multiplicity; the equality includes poles, not just regular places. The transcendence condition in $h_\varphi$ excludes $\varphi=0$ and $\varphi=1$, so $\varphi$, $\varphi-1$, and their product are nonzero here; the stated convention for the order of zero remains part of the order's definition. Finiteness of $C_\varphi$ is an input to this equality.
